rea.requirements: Pinned REA plus supported provider; native path requires matching Ghidra/JDK. Read installed reverse-engineer-anything skill; local transport does not make cloud agent responses private.

ghidra.requirements: Pinned Ghidra/JDK and host native decompiler; headless isolated analysis project.

radare2.requirements: Compatible loader/architecture and pinned release; use established CLI; one radare2-mcp bridge only when needed.

ilspy.requirements: CLI runtime for host; verified PE CLI metadata. Decompilation is inferred C#, not original source.

dnspyex.requirements: Windows and supported managed runtime; debugging/edits require scoped operation.

cpp2il.requirements: Matching native binary and IL2CPP metadata/version; imperfect recovered IL; validate against native semantics.

asar.requirements: Compatible Node release; inspect/list first, extract only to task-owned directory; ASAR is not encryption.

babel-parser.requirements: Pinned @babel/parser and matching syntax plugins; source text/AST, not native recovery.

acorn.requirements: Pinned parser with supported ECMAScript syntax; verify plugin support.

cdp.requirements: Version-matched protocol and already authorized browser/session; local debugging endpoint is privileged.

playwright.requirements: Compatible installed browser/runtime; controlled owned session. Do not launch browser/install downloads implicitly.

binwalk.requirements: Pinned release and parser support; signature scan first; extraction helpers isolated and separately reviewed.

fact.requirements: Linux/container stack with documented dependencies; analysis service and extractors need isolated local scope.

wabt.requirements: Supported core WASM feature set; wasm2wat/objdump/validate. wasm-decompile removed; wasm2c is translation only.

wasm-tools.requirements: Feature-matched module/component parser/validator. No runtime execution implicit.

wireshark.requirements: Wireshark/TShark, local PCAP/PCAPNG, name resolution disabled; capture is a separate operation.

scapy.requirements: Pinned Python and packet parser dependencies; offline read only unless sending/sniffing explicitly scoped.

gdb.requirements: Native target/remote platform compatibility, process ownership and attach permission.

lldb.requirements: Compatible debugger, symbols and process attach permissions; never bypass signing/security controls.

x64dbg.requirements: Windows owned process, x32dbg for x86 and x64dbg for x64; exact build baseline.

frida.requirements: Host/target versions and authorized process/device compatible; injection changes behavior and needs baseline.

ipsw.requirements: Verify installed build supports exact IPSW/OTA/dyld task and dependencies; no firmware/device execution or decryption bypass.

native.reason: Native PE/ELF/Mach-O interactive question: preserve established REA/Ghidra default; use compatible installed fallback.

native-batch.reason: Persistent project/batch exports favor headless Ghidra.

dotnet.reason: Managed metadata/IL present: read-only ILSpy before native disassembly.

unity-mono.reason: Unity managed CLI assemblies verified: ILSpy; retain actual engine/version evidence.

unity-il2cpp.reason: IL2CPP metadata plus native binary verified: Cpp2IL structural recovery; Ghidra fallback for native semantics.

electron.reason: Verified Electron/ASAR package: map main/preload/renderer IPC statically before observation.

javascript.reason: Use a syntax-compatible AST parser for source-level questions; native decompiler unnecessary.

browser.reason: Inspect authorized browser evidence with matching CDP; Playwright only for a controlled owned session.

firmware.reason: Recognized firmware/container: bounded signature inventory first; extract/emulate only under separate scope.

wasm.reason: WASM validation/inventory defaults to wasm-tools, including components; WABT supported core modules fallback.

wasm-core-text.reason: Core-module text and section inspection: WABT; never select removed wasm-decompile.

protocol.reason: Offline PCAP/PCAPNG decoding first, not active capture or fuzzing.

debug-pe.reason: Verified PE dynamic task: matching Windows debugger; no macOS/Linux process attachment assumed.

debug-elf.reason: Verified ELF runtime observation: GDB with LLDB compatible fallback.

debug-macho.reason: Verified Mach-O runtime observation: LLDB and authorized attach permissions.

debug-managed.reason: Managed runtime debugging is a Windows dnSpyEx route; ILSpy cannot substitute runtime evidence.

instrument.reason: Authorized native/IL2CPP runtime observation only after exact process and compatible agent validation.

apple-firmware.reason: Recognized Apple firmware format: inspect with Apple-aware tooling before generic firmware tools.
